title.narrative: Smallholder Dairy Development in Bangladesh, Myanmar and Thailand (SDDP): Improving the Bargaining Power and Sustainable Livelihood of Smallholder Dairy Farmers, through the Enhancement of Productivity and Market Access in Dairy. (CFC/FIGMDP/19)

description.narrative: The overall development objective of the project is to improve the bargaining power and sustainable livelihoods of smallholder milk producers in Asia through the enhancement of productivity and market access and in so-doing: br (1) move milk and dairy products safely and affordably to urban consumers; br (2) improve household food security, nutrition and healthy eating; br (3) reduce the incidence of rural poverty and sustainably increase family incomes; br (4) enhance development opportunities for women and youth; br (5) build national and regional capacity through the introduction of modern technologies and knowhow; br (6) safeguard the environment by promoting integrated farming and optimal use of local resources.
